verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the financial-model rule that personnel compensation uses actual session count multiplied by the per-session charge, with concrete HPI inputs and total.
The uncertainty concerns closing budget gaps through personnel adjustments or approved non-personnel lines, not the session-count calculation rule.

The client directs allocation of budget differences to approved non-personnel lines; this belongs to the independent non-personnel budget-allocation Requirement and does not modify the session-based formula.
The source resolves a non-personnel allocation question, so it does not resume the session-based personnel-calculation Requirement.
